_comment: Cards that exist only for the graveyard-replacement test (tests/unit/test_replace_graveyard.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_rip` is Rest in Peace's second line -- every card and token, every graveyard, from anywhere. `t_leyline_like` narrows it to one player's cards (Leyline of the Void), and `t_planar_void_like` narrows it by card type instead, so the two filters can be measured apart. `t_library_void` redirects to a library rather than exile, which is the Kozilek/Ulamog shape and the reason `destination` is a field.

cards.name: Test Rest In Peace
cards.oracle_text: If a card or token would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.

abilities.text: If a card or token would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.

cards.name: Test Leyline Void
cards.oracle_text: If a card would be put into an opponent's graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.

abilities.text: If a card would be put into an opponent's graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.

cards.name: Test Planar Void
cards.oracle_text: If a creature card would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.

abilities.text: If a creature card would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.

cards.oracle_text: If a card would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, put it into its owner's library instead.
